root_causes.description: Extreme p99 latency spike (z>1000) in quote service, 2.3s window mean vs baseline of 1.98ms. This is the most anomalous signal across all metrics and likely cascades downstream through shipping and checkout to the frontend.

Extreme memory usage spike (z=+8.97) in payment service, window mean 1.395e+08 bytes vs baseline 1.394e+08±1.6e+04. Likely secondary effect from holding connections open due to upstream latency issues.
High p99 latency spike (z=+6.98) in product-catalog service, window mean 29.4s vs baseline 23.47±0.85. Downstream dependency affecting checkout and frontend paths.

remediation_steps: Investigate quote service for resource saturation or downstream dependency failure - check pod events and container logs for OOM kills or crash loops
Scale payment service resources or investigate memory leak - review container memory working set and GC pauses
Verify product-catalog backend health and database query performance - check for recent deployments or schema changes
